Thanks Karthik / Elena — taking this. Quick notes after a first pass on the attachments:

1) Template choice: I'm leaning toward using Standard MSA v3 (internal template) with a data-residency addendum rather than accepting all counterparty edits in Streamline_MSA_Draft_v1. Their redline includes several one-sided indemnity tweaks and an expanded warranty section — we'll push back on unlimited indemnity and look to a 1x/2x liability cap depending on product classification.

2) Data residency: Hosted (shared) currently routes via us-west-2 / eu-west-1 depending on request — we can offer EU-only processing via a region pin but must confirm whether any of their tokenized logs / telemetry will be processed in US logging systems. If they require strict EU-only with no US access, Dedicated or Private may be the only fully compliant option. I'll confirm with infra and return an authoritative note by EOD Nov 6.

3) Order form: The seat calculations look fine; need a billing contact and PO number for invoicing cadence. Procurement requested 30 net; commercial preference would be to get annual prepay for ease, but we'll accept 30-net if needed for the pilot.

4) Evidence: I'll attach SOC 2 cover letter and our security questionnaire response. Elena — can you confirm whether they need the full SOC 2 report or an attestation? Also flag whether they require a DPIA.

5) Timeline: Nov 10 is tight but doable for a redline sketch + cover note; final negotiation will likely take longer. If infra confirms EU-only hosting is not immediate, we should propose a phased approach: pilot on hosted with pseudonymization + EU-region pin, then migrate to Dedicated if required.

Deliverables I plan to send Nov 10: redline PDF (commented MSA), cover memo with risk highlights and suggested concessions, and an Order Form cleanup.
